properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KABAKA w'eggulu n'ensi
Tukuwe-ekitiibwa kingi,
Tusuuta n'essanyu lingi
Ggwe-Omugabi.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Olw'obulamu n'essanyu
N'emirembe gyaffe gyonna,
Leero twebaza nnyo nnyini
Ggwe-Omugabi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Omwaka ggwe ogwengeza
Ne byonna-ebitusanyusa
Emmere n'eby'okwambala
Ggwe-obigaba.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Omwana wo omu yekka
Tewamugaana na kufa
Ku lwaffe abatasaana,
Abajeemu

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ebbanja lyaffe teriggwa;
Naye bye tukuleetedde
Biva kw'ebyo by'otwazika,
Tobinyooma.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Otufukeko-Omwoyo wo
Okutuyinzisa leero
Mu ntalo zaffe,tugobe
Omulabe.
